source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of propositional logic (PDF 27-28).

blocks.text: Propositional logic computer science mein use hone wali mantiq ki bunyadi shakal hai. Yeh un statements se kaam leti hai jo sach ya jhoot ho sakte hain; inhein propositions kehte hain (Fig 2.3).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Propositional logic mantiq ki sab se saada qism hai, lekin yeh computer ke tamam istidlal ki bunyad hai.

blocks.title: Proposition
blocks.text: Proposition aisa statement hai jo ya sach hai ya jhoot; aik hi waqt mein dono nahi ho sakta.

Sawalat aur hukm propositions nahi hote. Maslan 'Sooraj mashriq se nikalta hai' proposition hai. Proposition ka matlab wazeh hona chahiye aur uljhan wala nahi. Propositions mantiq ki bunyadi ikaiyan hain aur mantiqi expressions banane ke liye use hote hain. Proposition aam taur par P, Q ya R jaise bare harf se dikhaya jata hai; maslan P = 'Aasman neela hai'.

blocks.alt: Baen panel, propositions: P: Sooraj mashriq se nikalta hai (sach); Q: 2 + 2 = 5 (jhoot); R: barish ho rahi hai (aaj sach ya jhoot); note: sirf aik qeemat, dono kabhi nahi. Daen panel, propositions nahi: darwaza band karo (hukm); kya waqt hai? (sawal); x 5 se bara hai (x par munhasir, predicate); note: koi muqarrar sach ya jhoot nahi.
blocks.caption: Propositions aur woh jumle jo propositions nahi (Fig 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Proposition ka test saada hai: kya aap keh sakte hain ke yeh sach hai ya jhoot? Jhoota statement bhi proposition hai; sawal ya hukm nahi.

blocks.text: Saada proposition mein sirf aik statement hota hai aur use chhote hisson mein nahi tora ja sakta, maslan 'Barish ho rahi hai'. Murakkab (compound) proposition do ya zyada saade propositions ko mantiqi connectives se jor kar banta hai, maslan 'Barish ho rahi hai aur sardi hai'. Murakkab propositions pecheeda khayalat bayan kar sakte hain aur mantiqi istidlal mein aam hain.

Mantiqi connectives propositions ko jorte hain. AND tab sach hai jab dono statements sach hon; OR tab sach hai jab kam az kam aik sach ho; NOT statement ki sachai ulat deta hai (Fig 2.4). Connectives murakkab propositions banate, computer programs mein aam use hote, aur faisla sazi mein madad dete hain.

blocks.alt: Teen Venn diagrams. A AND B: do milte daire, sirf mushtarka hissa rangeen; sirf dono sach hon to sach. A OR B: dono daire rangeen; kam az kam aik sach ho to sach. NOT A: daira A ke bahar sab rangeen; A jhoot ho to sach.
blocks.caption: Mantiqi connectives AND, OR aur NOT (Fig 2.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Rangeen hissa dikhata hai ke har expression kahan sach hai. Alamat mein AND aksar oopar ki taraf wedge se likha jata hai, jaise mashq ke MCQ 6 mein.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaun se propositions hain? (a) Lahore Punjab mein hai. (b) Apni kitab kholo. (c) 7 jufat (even) number hai.
blocks.explanation: (a) aur (c) propositions hain: (a) sach aur (c) jhoot hai, lekin har aik ki muqarrar qeemat hai. (b) hukm hai, is liye proposition nahi.

items: Proposition: sach ya jhoot statement, dono kabhi nahi; naam P, Q, R.
Saada: aik statement; murakkab: connectives se jura.
AND: dono sach; OR: kam az kam aik sach; NOT: qeemat ulat.
